text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Yasuda Kinen. While waiting for the race to start, Matikanetannhauser opens a milk pudding she brought with her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Who's a delicious-looking little pudding? You are! Yes, you are!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, I heard Ikuno's running today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to race against her. Maybe I'll go to her waiting room later and say hi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hello, Tannhauser. I came to tell you I'm looking forward to running with you today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ikuno! We were just talking about you. I'm looking forward to running with you too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Let's have a safe and good race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: …Oh. Is that…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Is that pudding from the dorm fridge?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Good eye! I brought it as my snack today!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Don't eat that! If I remember correctly, I believe it's five days past its expiration date!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hurriedly checks the expiration date to find… it expired five days ago!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That was a close one! Thanks, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome. I'm glad I came over to say hello.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It would be a shame if a rival as important as you fell ill before the race.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes. Why don't I check the condition of your cleats as well? Just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Y-you're too kind, Ikuno!
